description.value:
You transform raw materials into finished goods of the same substance — turning a stand of trees into lumber for a bridge, hemp into rope, or bantha hide into clothing, for example.

Choosing raw material you can see within range, you can fabricate a Large or smaller object (fitting within a 10-foot cube, or up to eight connected 5-foot cubes) if enough material is available; if the material is metal, stone, or another mineral, the finished object can be no larger than Medium. The result is only as well-made as the material allows.

This power cannot create creatures or enhanced items, nor items normally requiring specialized craftsmanship — such as jewelry, weapons, glass, or armor — unless you are proficient with the appropriate tool.
